text:
violet_cs: Drafting a one-paragraph handoff + tiny checklist for hybrid accounts (mix of server and client calls). Need something short ops + eng can share during onboarding.

violet_cs: Key points to surface: avoid double-counting tokens across client/server, prefer concat for single-response flows, small batches for independent tasks, stream for live UX only. Also include renewal triage triggers.

kevin_se: paste-ready snippets please (1 curl batch + 1 streaming toggle). Also call out header X-Call-Side: client|server so CS can map usage in dashboard.

violet_cs: added snippets and header note.

violet_cs: ```
# batch curl (server-side flush)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Call-Side: server" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","inputs":["summary: msg","rewrite: msg2"],"max_tokens":120,"stream":false}'

# sdk one-liner to enable streaming (client)
await client.generate({model:'redwood-small', input:prompt, stream:true})
```

sam_sre: ops bullets to add to handout: cache prefix TTL=30s for client sessions, per-tenant concurrency=3 default, mark server-side flushes with header so routing can prefer low-latency pools. Add fallback rule: if p90 latency >500ms for 45s, switch mobile clients to batch-only mode and reduce max_tokens by 30%.

violet_cs: added SRE notes. Also included renewal triage logic: set 'renewal_triage' when either (a) 7-day rolling avg token use >70% of monthly quota OR (b) client+server combined peak day >85% of quota. Trigger creates CS task and suggests: prompt audit, concat vs batch review, temporary burst grant.

morgan_pm: include outreach script: "Hi <name> we noticed your combined usage is nearing your monthly budget. Can we run a short prompt audit or enable a temporary burst to avoid disruption?" Keep it simple.

health_bot: Confluence page created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/hybrid-account-triage (access: customer-success, product)

violet_cs: small UX tip for customers: when mixing client/server, send session-start prefill server-side to avoid duplicate priming on client reconnects. And emit X-Call-Side header so CS can split metrics.

kevin_se: nit: call out example of concatenation: join messages with "\n---\n" when you need a cohesive single answer; cheaper than parallel batches for output tokens.

violet_cs: done. Planning to attach this to the low-touch hybrid template and to renewal alerts. Please comment before EOD or I'll publish.
